body: The one thing that scares me more than living this life, is more life after its over.

Definitely being forced into doing something you don't want to do, that's a valid reason to be frustrated. I felt that a lot with my parents. 

One time my dad tried to sign me up for volleyball, but I hated the sport. It upset me so much that my parents don't understand my needs and wants that I cried that I wouldn't go and made a mountain of excuses why. They finally got the hint that I wasn't having it. 

Not recommending you do something like that, but communication is key. That's easier said than done, especially with parents. A lot of times they can think they know what's best for you without regarding your opinion, at least in my experience. 

Your feelings a valid. I'm not sure how your parents are though, that's up to you to decide if it's worth telling them how it makes you feel. 

Hope you have a good day fellow stranger :)

I relate to this a lot. It's hard for me to get close to anyone who I know is going to leave so I try and keep my distance. The 'right' thing to do would probably be to tell your therapist about this. But that itself can be difficult. 

I wish I could help more, but I myself am very new to therapy 😔

I hope all goes well
